remarks: 3 bed/ 1.5 bath Victorian home, blt. 1903 w/ a 2 story addt in 2010 & addtl renovations in 2014. Meticulously detailed to marry modern style with original Victorian features. A large turret on the wrap around porch is the perfect place to entertain. Gourmet kitchen w/ custom wood kitchen cabinets from Majestic Kitchens, stainless appliances & granite breakfast bar. Fine millwork throughout the home, with details like crown & cornice molding, coffered ceilings, picture rails, wood panels, stained glass, hardwood floors. The formal dining room features a detailed parquet wood floor w/ millwork from corner to corner. The family/living room soaked by the sun through the bay windows. Rear sunroom with coat closet and exterior door to rear porch. Powder room on 1st fl. On the 2nd floor is bedrm 1 with a deep closet, bedrms 2&3 are railroad style, both are spacious and sunlit. Hall bath renovated in 2014 includes custom wood cabinetry and glass enclosed shower. Laundry/storage room on the 2nd floor is a great convenience. Enjoy morning coffee or watching fireworks on on the balcony. Lush .12 acre landscaped yard w/ japanese maples, lillys, irishes, hostas and thoughtfully planned shrubs and border gardens. Heated shed at back of house. Basement w/ workshop, and storage rms. Sloped driveway bordered with stone retaining wall and lower rock garden. First house built on this quiet dead end road. Walk to train, school, library, shops, beach, tennis, town pool, ball fields and harbor.
